# v2.61-dev Release Notes

## Improved: clearer detail when you expand a "Who to certify" row

On **Programs › Compliance Planning**, expanding a person in the "Who to certify"
table used to show a terse, hard-to-read fragment for each gap they close. Each
line is now a plain-language sentence, worded to match that person's situation:

- **Easy win** — "They have taken *Training A*. Passing the *Cert A* certification
  exam will contribute to the *Specialisation Y* specialisation."
- **Lapsed** — "They previously held *Cert A*, but it has expired. Renewing it will
  contribute to the *Specialisation Y* specialisation."
- **Legacy upgrade** — "They hold the legacy certification *Cert B*. Upgrading to
  *Cert A* will contribute to the *Specialisation Y* specialisation."

A person who closes several gaps gets one sentence per gap (with the right
specialisation each time), and each line still shows the program and scope beneath
it plus the colour-coded move type. Where a gap isn't tied to a specialisation, the
wording falls back to the tier or the requirement.
